text: Python 编程与 AI 应用开发
PLC 控制系统设计（西门子 S7）
LoomLLM 多智能体协作系统：基于 Python 的 AI 任务调度框架，支持多后端 LLM 自动路由与质量门控。
学习通自动化工具：基于 OCR 和 PyAutoGUI 的自动化答题脚本，实现屏幕识别与自动操作。
篮球、编程、阅读技术文档

I am Chen Xinghang, an Electrical Engineering student from Foshan, Guangdong. I specialize in PLC control system design for Siemens S7 platforms and Python-based AI application development. My key project, LoomLLM, is a multi-agent collaboration framework that automatically routes tasks to different AI models with quality control. I also built an automation tool using OCR and PyAutoGUI for screen recognition. In my spare time, I enjoy basketball and coding. I aim to become an electrical engineer who bridges traditional industry and modern AI technology.
